purpose: Tests whether authoritative real-world evidence supports classification and/or section geometry. No coordinates or elevations are invented.

cases.case_location: Yokohama municipal mapped area; no individual polygon selected
cases.gsi_artificial_class: 谷埋め型大規模盛土造成地
source_facts: Old maps/aerial photographs were compared with FY2002-FY2007 digital mapping.
Field reconnaissance confirmed mapped filled areas.
Vertical and horizontal uncertainty is about 1 m; prewar areas may be 3-5 m.

cases.case_location: Tokyo Port reclaimed-land domain; no borehole/profile selected
source_facts: Tokyo Port ground map is based on about 5,000 boreholes and 40,000 soil tests.
Tokyo publishes water-area transition and landfill-material layers.

cases.case_location: National direct-controlled-road database; no road section selected
source_facts: The database represents completed road form as two-dimensional GIS data.
It does not by itself provide pre-construction ground or fill thickness.

cases.case_location: Sendai map coverage; no individual cell selected
source_facts: 1958-1968 old city planning maps are compared with 2008 GSI base-map information.
Changes below 1 m are outside classification capability.
No borehole investigation was performed for the map.
